where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
what_to_do: Check line prices, totals, Finance card, Stats tab.
expected_result: All money visible. Service Manager has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: a role with 'See Financial Data' ON (which the Service Manager role has) must see every dollar figure on a work order — line prices, the Rate/Margin/Total columns, the Financial Info card, the Stats tab money, and the Finance tab invoice. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Service Manager row #9 'Pricing shows (See Financial ON)']
expected_plain: Logged in as a Service Manager, every price and dollar amount on a work order should be visible, nothing hidden or blanked.
actual_result_plain: Opened work order S9-24661 as Tech-with-Service-Manager. All money was visible everywhere. The left Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $929.72, Shop Supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71, Balance $1,078.71. The Lines grid showed the Rate ($232.43), Margin (100%) and Total ($929.72) columns with values. The Stats tab showed the Hours, Labor, Parts and Total breakdowns with Sell price/Cost/Margin/% dollar figures ($929.72 sell, $0 cost, 100% margin). The Finance tab showed the full invoice INV-S9-24661 with Labor $929.72, Parts $0.00, Shop supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST(5%) $51.37, Total $1,078.71 and Balance $1,078.71. Nothing was hidden or masked.
notes: See Financial Data confirmed ON in the Service Manager fe-permissions (seeFinancialData:true). Money confirmed on Lines, Financial Info card, Stats tab and Finance tab.
